title: not that other one
description: a simple, vanilla plus modpack, that makes minecraft better.
body:
# a simple, vanilla plus modpack, that makes minecraft _better_.

This modpack was born from my friend group's desire to make minecraft not only more convenient, but beauiful and immersive. At it's core this is a vanilla minecraft experience, with a handful of thoughtfully selected and balanced mods that improve the default minecraft gameplay loop. Oh, and it runs like a dream, highly-optimized.

## Major Inclusions:
- BetterThanMending - Improves Mending Enchantment.
- Completionist's Index - Helps track achievements and light progression.
- Dungeons and Taverns - Light Structure Mod.
- Easy Anvils - Improved Anvils.
- Easy Magic - Improved Enchanting.
- Essential - Social and World Sharing.
- Female Gender Mod - Makes Mahoro Happy. 
- Fishing Expansion - Better Fishing Loot Table, New Boss.
- From The Fog - Added Herobrine.
- Grind Enchantments - Improved Grindstone.
- Litematic, Axiom - Building Improvements.
- Pufferfish's Attributes & Skills - Light RPG-like Skill Tree.
- Tax Free Levels - How it should be.
- Tectonic - Improved World-gen.
- Waystones - Traveling made seamless.
- Voxy - World LOD, View Distance Improvements. 

### Other Inculsions:
- Elytra Trims, Tool Trims, 3D Skin Layers, Visuality, WaveyCapes, Xaero's(...)

(_Recommended Use with VanillaTweaks Resource Pack._)

**Play this vanilla plus pack, not that other one.**
